title: calamintha glandulosa
intro: Calamintha glandulosa, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Calamintha glandulosa include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
